item.title: Police Find 26 Rare Hellenistic Spearheads in Foreign National's Ptolemaida House
item.description: Police in Ptolemaida uncovered 26 spearheads from the Hellenistic period (323–30 BC) during a search of a 44-year-old foreign national's residence. The discovery followed his arrest in Thessaloniki on unrelated charges. Additional items seized include rings, watches, a camera, and an unidentified white powder.
